market.question: Will Trump agree to Iranian oil sanction relief by May 31?

assessment.reasoning: Negotiations active May 2026 (peace deal terms include sanctions relief). However, Trump publicly threatening higher-intensity bombing on May 6 absent a deal suggests imminent agreement is uncertain. March 2026 had a partial sanctions waiver on already-loaded crude — depending on resolution criteria this may already count, but Polymarket likely requires a formal deal. Subjective.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Resolution criteria — does an existing partial waiver count? Pace of negotiations.
